job.title: Account Manager - South
job.description:
Account Manager – Equine & Veterinary
South of England
Base salary up to £55K + Company Bonus + Car
  
Are you an equine veterinary nurse, clinician or animal health professional looking to take your career in a more commercial direction?
We’re working with a highly regarded business within the veterinary and animal health sector, with an established and diverse portfolio of products across the equine and small animal markets.
They’re looking for an Account Manager to build relationships with veterinary practices, referral hospitals and equine referral centres across the South of England.
You don’t need a long track record in sales. What matters most is your clinical credibility, understanding of the veterinary and equine market, commercial curiosity and ability to build trusted relationships.
  
Why This Role?
A genuine opportunity to move into commercial animal health. Your clinical knowledge and understanding of the industry will give you the credibility to open doors and have meaningful conversations with veterinary professionals.
A broad product portfolio. You’ll have a variety of products and solutions to work with, creating opportunities to introduce new products, upsell and cross-sell rather than relying on one or two core products.
A collaborative culture. There are no individual sales targets driving the bonus structure. Success is shared, with company performance forming the basis of the bonus scheme.
Support to help you succeed. You’ll receive coaching and mentoring from an experienced senior sales professional. It’s a lean team, but you’ll have access to experienced colleagues and resources across the wider business.
A territory you can manage intelligently. This is a large geographical area, but it’s not about spending every day in the car. Good diary management, territory planning and prioritisation will be key to achieving your commercial goals.
  
The Ideal Candidate Profile
We’d welcome applications from:
  • Equine Veterinary Nurses
  • Equine Clinicians
  • Veterinary professionals
  • Animal Science graduates
  • Veterinary Science or related degree holders
  • Other candidates with relevant equine or animal health experience
  
You’ll ideally bring:
  • A strong understanding of the equine and/or veterinary market
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
  • Commercial awareness and an appetite to develop your sales capability
  • Strong organisation, diary management and territory planning skills
  • Confidence engaging with veterinary professionals and referral hospitals
  • An understanding of compliance and regulation within the animal health sector
  • The judgement to recognise when a technical or regulatory question sits outside your knowledge and confidently involve an appropriately qualified senior or clinical colleague
  • A proactive, collaborative and results-focused approach
  
The Role
You’ll take responsibility for developing your territory and building long-term relationships with veterinary practices and referral hospitals.
You’ll identify customer needs, introduce relevant products and solutions, provide product support and training where appropriate, and look for opportunities to grow existing relationships.
You’ll also maintain accurate CRM records, monitor competitor and market activity, attend relevant events and exhibitions, and work closely with colleagues across the commercial, clinical and marketing functions.
  
Could This Be You?
If you have a clinical or scientific background, understand the equine market and enjoy building professional relationships, this could be an excellent opportunity to develop your commercial career.
You don’t need to be a natural-born salesperson. If you’re credible, curious, organised and confident enough to open doors and build trust, we’d love to hear from you.
Applications are welcomed from candidates across the South of England who are comfortable managing a large territory and committed to investing the time needed to build effective customer relationships.
  
Please apply here to register your interest and we’ll call you to discuss the opportunity further.

job.title: Finance Manager
job.description:
Finance Manager
Stevenage, Hertfordshire
£55,000–£60,000 depending on experience
Permanent | Full time

Office-based, with the option to work from home one day per week once established

The Animal People Recruitment Company is excited to be partnering with an ambitious, entrepreneurial consumer-products business to appoint a commercially minded Finance Manager.

Based in Stevenage, our client develops, manufactures and distributes a growing portfolio of consumer and pet-care brands across the UK and international markets. With multiple trading and property entities, this is a varied and influential opportunity for someone who wants to become the number-one finance person within a successful owner-managed group.

You will work directly with the Managing Director, lead a small established finance team and take ownership of the group’s financial performance, reporting and controls.

This is much more than a traditional management accounts role. You will be close to the commercial decisions, helping the business understand profitability, manage cash, improve margins and plan confidently for continued growth.

The opportunity

As Finance Manager, you will:
  • Lead the day-to-day finance function across multiple group entities
  • Produce accurate monthly management accounts across P&L, balance sheet and cash flow
  • Maintain a rolling 12-week cash-flow forecast
  • Manage working capital, debtors, creditors, stock and loan balances
  • Lead budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and scenario planning
  • Provide clear commercial insight to the Managing Director
  • Analyse profitability across products, customers, suppliers and sales channels
  • Support pricing, promotions, investment and supplier negotiations
  • Work closely with operations and supply chain to improve manufacturing and gross margins
  • Strengthen financial controls, reporting tools, systems and processes
  • Ensure compliance across VAT, PAYE, Corporation Tax and other statutory requirements
  • Lead, support and develop the existing finance team
  • Manage relationships with external accountants and professional advisers
About you

You could currently be working as a Finance Manager, Financial Controller, Senior Management Accountant or Finance Business Partner and be ready to take broader ownership.

You will ideally have:
  • Strong management accounts, cash-flow and working-capital experience
  • The ability to turn financial information into clear commercial recommendations
  • Experience working directly with an MD, business owner or senior leadership team
  • Experience leading or developing a small finance team
  • A practical, hands-on approach and willingness to work within the detail
  • Strong Excel and financial systems capability
  • Confidence improving processes and constructively challenging existing ways of working
  • A collaborative and approachable communication style
Experience within manufacturing, FMCG, consumer goods, pet care, cosmetics, wholesale, distribution, e-commerce, import/export or another stock-led environment would be particularly valuable.

An ACCA, CIMA or ACA qualification would be advantageous, but our client is equally open to part-qualified or qualified-by-experience candidates who can demonstrate the necessary breadth, commercial understanding and leadership capability.

Why consider this opportunity? This is a chance to become a genuinely influential part of an entrepreneurial business where your work will be visible and your ideas will be heard.

You will benefit from:
  • Direct access to the Managing Director
  • Genuine ownership of the finance function
  • An existing team to lead and develop
  • Exposure to multiple brands, entities and commercial projects
  • The freedom to improve systems and introduce better ways of working
  • The opportunity to shape the finance function as the business develops
  • A salary of £55,000–£60,000 depending on experience
  • The option to work from home one day per week once established
This is a highly collaborative role at the centre of the business. You must therefore be able to work from the Stevenage office for a minimum of four days each week. Candidates who would prefer to be in the office full time are equally welcome.

If you are looking for greater ownership, commercial influence and the opportunity to help shape the next stage of a growing business, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Katie Fletcher at The Animal People Recruitment Company for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Health, Safety & Environmental Manager
job.description:
Health, Safety & Environmental Manager - Manufacturing
 
Location: East Yorkshire
Salary: £40,000+ depending on experience
Bonus: Annual management bonus of up to 10%
Contract: Permanent, full time
Working pattern: Predominantly site-based, with the potential for one day working from home following probation
 
Are you an experienced Health, Safety and Environmental professional looking for a role where you can build on strong foundations rather than spend your first year firefighting?
 
We're recruiting a Health, Safety & Environmental Manager for an established, family-owned pet food manufacturer in East Yorkshire.
 
This is a rare opportunity to inherit a mature, well-managed HSE function from a highly experienced manager who is retiring after several successful years with the business. You'll receive a structured handover and take ownership of systems, documentation and processes that are already in an excellent position.
 
From there, you'll have the autonomy and senior-level support to continue improving standards, strengthen the company's proactive safety culture and help shape its long-term HSE strategy.
 
The role
This is a varied, standalone position covering health, safety and environmental management across a food manufacturing, warehouse and office environment.
 
Reporting directly to the Deputy Managing Director, you'll work closely with managers and colleagues throughout the business to ensure health, safety and environmental responsibility remains embedded in everyday operations and decision-making.
 
You'll be joining a well-maintained site with established processes and a workforce that understands the importance of HSE. This isn't a reactive role in a business struggling with compliance. It's an opportunity to protect what already works, identify further improvements and lead the next stage of the company's HSE development.

What you'll be doing
 You'll take ownership of the company's HSE management systems, ensuring continued legal compliance, effective risk management and ongoing environmental improvement.
 
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Developing and delivering the company's health, safety and environmental strategy
  • Ensuring compliance with relevant HSE and environmental legislation
  • Managing risk assessments covering machinery, COSHH, fire, DSEAR and workplace activities
  • Leading accident, incident and near-miss investigations
  • Completing root cause analysis and monitoring corrective actions
  • Managing RIDDOR reporting where required
  • Maintaining standard operating procedures and HSE documentation
  • Leading contractor controls and permit-to-work systems
  • Chairing the Health and Safety Committee
  • Delivering toolbox talks and coaching managers to take ownership of safety within their teams
  • Managing environmental compliance, including waste, trade effluent, packaging obligations, energy and water usage
  • Supporting carbon reduction, water reduction and waste valorisation projects
  • Preparing for and co-hosting BRC, customer and regulatory audits
  • Monitoring HSE performance through meaningful KPIs
  • Producing monthly HSE reports for the senior leadership team
  • Developing and maintaining the annual HSE training matrix
  • Supporting the continued development of a proactive, prevention-led safety culture
  • Owning and delivering the company's five-year HSE strategy
The manufacturing environment includes grain handling, extrusion, thermal processing, high-speed packing lines, forklifts, chemical handling, animal by-products and engineering activities.
 
About you
You'll be an experienced Health, Safety and Environmental professional with a practical, hands-on approach and the confidence to operate as the lead HSE specialist within a small to medium-sized manufacturing business.
 
You'll ideally have:
  • Significant HSE experience within a manufacturing environment
  • A NEBOSH Diploma or be actively working towards one
  • Chartered IOSH membership or be working towards CMIOSH status
  • Strong knowledge of UK health, safety and environmental legislation
  • Experience managing risk assessments and safe operating procedures
  • Strong accident and incident investigation capabilities
  • Experience supporting or leading regulatory, customer or certification audits
  • Knowledge of environmental permits and environmental compliance
  • Experience producing HSE data, KPIs and senior-level reports
  • The confidence to engage, influence and coach colleagues at every level
Experience within food, animal feed or pet food manufacturing would be particularly valuable. Knowledge of BRC standards, ISO 14001, ATEX environments or dust explosion risks would also be advantageous.
 
You don't need to tick every desirable box. What matters most is a strong manufacturing HSE background, sound technical knowledge and the ability to take ownership of a varied standalone role.
 
What's on offer?
  • Salary of £40,000+ depending on experience
  • Annual management bonus of up to 10% of salary
  • Workplace pension
  • Annual leave increasing with length of service
  • Potential for one working-from-home day per week following probation
  • A structured handover with the retiring HSE Manager
  • Direct access to senior decision-makers
  • The autonomy to influence HSE strategy and culture
  • An established HSE function with strong systems already in place
Most importantly, you'll inherit a function that has been carefully developed over several years—allowing you to focus on continuous improvement, culture and long-term impact.
 
If you're currently working as an HSE Manager, Health and Safety Manager, SHE Manager, EHS Manager or are an experienced HSE Advisor ready to step into a broader management role, we'd love to hear from you.
 
Apply today! The Animal People Recruitment Company look forward to receiving your application!

job.title: National Account Manager
job.description:

Grocery & Discount Retail | Pet Industry

We're recruiting on behalf of one of Europe's fastest-growing pet brands, looking for an ambitious National Account Manager who wants to play a pivotal role in building their UK grocery business.
 
Already established across multiple European markets, the business has developed an exciting portfolio of pet brands that are gaining significant traction with retailers. Reporting directly into the founders, you'll take ownership of developing existing grocery relationships while driving new business across national retailers and discount channels.
 
This is a highly autonomous role where your ideas, energy and commercial thinking will genuinely influence the direction of the UK business.

...a loyal customer base...
...an exceptional reputation...

  • You'll work closely with commercial teams, agencies and external partners.

Around two-thirds of the business is generated through trade, making this an incredibly commercial marketing role where you'll directly support independent retailers, wholesalers and buying groups while continuing to build an already trusted brand.

You'll have ownership of:

  • Campaign planning and delivery
  • Agency management
  • Marketing budgets

  • Building stronger relationships across the pet industry
This role is perfect for someone who...
Loves making things happen.
Can organise multiple projects without dropping the ball.
Thrives in fast-moving businesses.
Enjoys balancing creativity with commercial thinking.
Builds relationships easily.
Takes ownership without waiting to be asked.
Wants to be recognised for delivering results.

We'd especially love to hear from people with experience in:

  • Animal health
  • Veterinary
  • Premium FMCG
  • Consumer brands
  • Nutrition
  • Lifestyle brands
  • Retail marketing
  • Trade marketing
  • Brand marketing
  • B2B marketing
If you don't come directly from the pet industry but have experience within a premium consumer brand, we'd still love to hear from you.

What you'll receive
  • £40k+ DOE salary
  • Performance-related bonus
  • Hybrid working
  • Generous annual leave, including additional service-related holiday
  • Christmas shutdown
  • Workplace pension
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Staff discount
  • Pet-friendly office
  • Genuine investment in your professional development

The successful person won't just join a marketing team.

They'll help shape it.
You'll be trusted.
You'll have influence.
You'll work with leaders who genuinely value new ideas.

job.title: Export Sales & Business Manager
job.description:
Export Sales & Business Manager – Equine Nutrition
Location: East Anglia / Field-Based
Salary: £50,000–£65,000 basic + bonus/commission + travel expenses
Sector: Equine Nutrition / Animal Health
Type: Full-time

The opportunity

Are you an experienced international sales professional with an established network across the equine, animal nutrition or agricultural markets?

This could be an opportunity to make a real impact within a family-owned British business with almost 50 years of experience in equine nutrition and supplementation.

With products manufactured on site and made to order, the business has built its reputation around quality, science-led formulations and a genuine understanding of equine nutrition. It is a small but ambitious team, with significant potential to grow its presence across international markets.

They're now looking for an Export Sales & Business Manager to take that growth to the next level.

This is a genuinely global role. Europe represents an exciting area of growth, but the remit extends across international markets, so we're looking for someone who already understands international distribution and ideally has an established network of contacts they can leverage.

This is not simply an account management role. You'll be expected to identify new markets, open doors, find the right distributors and commercial partners, and turn those relationships into profitable, sustainable business.

Key responsibilities

International Business Development
  • Develop and execute international sales strategies across global markets.
  • Identify and develop new territories, distributors, agents, retailers and commercial partners.
  • Proactively prospect for new business and generate opportunities through your existing network.
  • Research market trends, customer needs and competitive activity to identify opportunities for growth.
Sales & Account Management
  • Deliver export sales and profitability targets.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with international distributors, agents and key customers.
  • Develop long-term partnerships and maximise opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Negotiate pricing, commercial agreements and contracts.
International Market Development
  • Develop territory plans and sales forecasts.
  • Identify effective routes to market and opportunities for market penetration.
  • Provide insight into international markets to support wider commercial and product development.
  • Monitor market risks, currency fluctuations and developments that may affect international trade.
Brand Representation
  • Represent the business internationally at customer meetings, trade shows and industry events.
  • Build the company's profile and reputation within relevant equine, feed and animal nutrition markets.
  • Act as a credible and knowledgeable ambassador for a quality British brand.
Export Operations & Compliance
  • Ensure international sales activity complies with export regulations, customs requirements and international trade legislation.
  • Work closely with logistics, operations and finance to ensure efficient order fulfilment.
  • Oversee export documentation and shipping processes.
How will success be measured?

You'll have clear commercial objectives, with performance measured against:
  • Export sales revenue growth
  • New customer acquisition
  • Market expansion and territory development
  • Gross profit margin
  • Customer retention and satisfaction
  • Forecast accuracy
  • Export compliance and operational efficiency
This is a role where you'll be able to see the direct impact of your work: opening new markets, building distribution networks and contributing to the continued international growth of an established British business.

What are we looking for?

We're much more interested in what you've achieved than the qualifications you have.

Ideally, you'll already have experience in export sales, international business development or commercial management, with a proven track record of developing international distribution and delivering sales growth.

Experience within the equine sector would be particularly valuable, but we're also open to candidates from animal nutrition, feed or the wider agricultural markets.


We're particularly interested in people who have:
  • Existing relationships with international distributors, agents, retailers or commercial partners.
  • A strong understanding of international distribution and routes to market.
  • A proven ability to identify and develop new territories.
  • A genuine hunter mentality and the drive to create new business rather than simply manage an existing customer base.
  • Strong commercial, negotiation and influencing skills.
  • The confidence to build relationships across different international markets and cultures.
  • Experience working autonomously and managing multiple international accounts.
  • An understanding of export procedures, international trade and compliance.
  • The enthusiasm to travel extensively and represent a business at international events and exhibitions.
A degree is not essential. Your practical experience, industry knowledge, commercial results and international network are far more important.

Why join?

You'll be joining a business with nearly five decades of experience, an established reputation for quality and a strong product proposition, while still having the agility of a small, entrepreneurial team.
More importantly, you'll have the opportunity to help shape the next phase of its international growth.

If you're someone who enjoys opening doors, building relationships and turning untapped markets into successful territories, this role gives you the scope to make a real difference.

Salary: £50,000–£65,000 basic + bonus/commission, with travel expenses covered.

Location: Ideally within commuting distance of the company's East Anglia site, although a field-based arrangement will be considered for the right candidate.

International travel: Significant travel will be required as part of the role.
Interested?

If you're an experienced export or international sales professional with the network, commercial drive and industry knowledge to take on this opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

Please register your interest by applying via the link below.

Veterinary Clinical Systems Specialist

London Paddington (4 days office-based minimum)
Up to £80,000 + outstanding benefits package

We’re partnering with an innovative, fast-growing AI technology business that is transforming the way veterinary clinics operate through intelligent software systems, workflow optimisation, and data-driven solutions.

This is a genuinely unique opportunity to join a highly collaborative, ambitious, and forward-thinking team at a pivotal stage of growth.

The business combines cutting-edge AI capability with real-world clinical understanding to create smarter systems that improve operational efficiency, decision-making, and clinical outcomes within veterinary environments.

They are now looking for a Veterinary Clinical Systems Specialist to act as the bridge between clinical operations and technical delivery teams.

This role would suit someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments and enjoys solving complex operational problems through systems thinking, communication, and technology.

Please note you need to be a qualified Veterinary Surgeon to apply.

The Role
Working closely with AI, product, and software teams, you’ll help translate veterinary clinical workflows into scalable technical solutions and intelligent system improvements.

Our client is looking for candidates to demonstrate how they would approach the design and evaluation of an AI-enabled clinical recommendation tool. They are looking for the candidates to design a clear framework around defining success measures, evaluating outcomes, and connecting the practical requirements of the consultation room with the capabilities of an AI solution.

This is a highly visible role within the business and offers genuine ownership, influence, and progression potential.

Who you are 
  • Veterinary or Medical Degree with clinical experience
  • Experience working with clinical or healthcare data (SQL is a plus)
  • Familiarity with clinical coding systems (e.g. SNOMED, ICD)
  • Interest in LLMs and prompt engineering
  
What the job involves  
  • Evaluate and improve the performance of clinical AI models and datasets
  • Work closely with users to launch new features, capture medical feedback, and translate it into product requirements
  • Turn clinical expertise into high-quality data and evidence-based recommendations to improve care
  • Collaborate with the AI team on research initiatives (e.g. preventative healthcare, clinical decision support

The Environment
This is not a traditional corporate environment.

The company has built a collaborative, ambitious, and people-focused culture where employees are encouraged to contribute ideas, take ownership, and help shape the future of the business.

The team works closely together in person and values visibility, communication, collaboration, and shared momentum. As such, this role requires a minimum of four days per week onsite in Paddington, London.

In return, the business offers:
  • A highly competitive salary package
  • Excellent benefits and wellbeing support
  • Strong long-term growth potential
  • A social, dynamic, and collaborative culture
  • Exposure to cutting-edge AI technology
  • The opportunity to make genuine impact in a scaling business
If you’re excited by the idea of helping shape AI-powered systems within the veterinary sector and want to be part of a business entering a significant growth phase, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply to register your interest and we'll be in touch to tell you more!
